verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say you can issue Visa debit or credit cards to team members, define roles and set spend limits, including up to 50 virtual or physical debit cards. Role-based team access is also documented. An independent review confirms physical cards exist, citing their daily and ATM limits. missing for 10: explicit evidence that credit cards (not just debit) come in physical form, step-by-step docs on issuing cards and configuring roles, hands-on corroboration of the role workflow.
